what: Review cards are pinned 9° apart around a point 9.8x the card height below, lined up like the top of a big wheel (duplicated so they fill both screen edges). Dragging a card turns the wheel with the hand, and on release it glides with inertia (resistance 2000) and snaps to the nearest slot within .5~1s. The prev/next buttons and dots turn with 1s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,0,1), and clicking a side card brings it to the center. The center card gets is-active, and the number slot shows 01·02… Phone is 8°·10.6x
needs: InertiaPlugin (inertia — without it, it snaps back to the slot on release)

options.--fx-step: Angle between cells (CSS variable), default 9deg (8deg at 767px and below)
options.--fx-radius: Distance to the axis (card height %, CSS variable), default 980% (1060% at 767px or less)
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Dot buttons (as many as real cards)
